catches: Influee's '$20 per video' figure is the brand-side starting price (what brands pay), not a creator pay rate — creator take-home is net of the platform's cut.

All content rights belong to the brand by default — you hand over full usage rights (paid ads, organic, everything) in the base price.
Pay is per campaign and varies by market (benchmarked ~$82/video USA, ~$84 UK, ~$75 Canada, ~$49 Australia) — earnings depend on winning campaigns.
Brands may need subscriptions ($199-$749/mo) to run campaigns, which affects how many campaigns exist to win.

steps: Join Influee as a creator (free for creators, no subscription) and build your portfolio.
Browse brand campaigns on the marketplace — note the per-video budget shown on each campaign.
Apply to campaigns in your niche; brands select the creators.
Create the content per the brief (unlimited revisions are included on the platform).

Deliver and get paid per campaign — the per-video price starts around $20 on the brand side; your take-home is net of Influee's platform commission (their pages cite both 10% and 20% — confirm your actual rate in your creator agreement).
